text: 1、沪指早间横盘震荡，创业板指跌超1%。AI漫剧概念再度爆发，果麦文化、新经典、引力传媒、慈文传媒等多股涨停。PCB概念延续涨势，满坤科技、金禄电子、澳弘电子、宝鼎科技等涨停。油气股拉升，博迈科涨停。下跌方面，风电板块下挫，威力传动、大金重工跌超8%。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市超3600股飘绿，上午半天成交8608亿。午间收盘沪指涨0.01%，深成指跌0.51%，创业板跌1.15%。 2、板块概念方面，游戏、油气、影视传媒、PCB等板块领涨；风电设备、汽车整车、电池、零售等板块领跌； 3、两市共1590只个股上涨，45只个股涨停；3471只个股下跌，5只个
text_en: 1. The Shanghai Composite Index fluctuated sideways in the morning, while the ChiNext Index fell more than 1%. The AI comic-drama concept surged again, with Guomai Culture, New Classic, Yinli Media, Ciwen Media and many other stocks hitting the daily limit. The PCB concept continued its upward trend, with Mankun Technology, Jinlu Electronics, Aohong Electronics, Baoding Technology and others hitting the daily limit. Oil and gas stocks rallied, with Bomeike hitting the daily limit. On the downside, the wind power sector fell, with Weili Transmission and Dajin Heavy Industry down more than 8%. More stocks fell than rose, with more than 3,600 stocks declining across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets, and half-day turnover of 860.8 billion yuan. At the midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.01%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.51%, and the ChiNext Index fell 1.15%. 2.
